observations: A used transmission housing with a 30-pin gear box.
Rust and dirt are visible on the exterior of the housing.
The housing is shown from a side and front angle.
A watermark for 'LOTTEK INVESTMENT' is visible across the center.
The background shows another engine and a pulley.
The item is resting on a dark, possibly concrete, surface.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be seized, stripped, or have internal mechanical failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the transmission being shifted through all gears.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be a generic or third-party part rather than a genuine Toyota part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the side or top).

risks.risk: The item may be a used part from a different vehicle model.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's identification plate.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the gearbox.
Video of the gearbox being shifted through all gears.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
